prompt: Rebuild `Save` so a crash can never leave a half-written database: write a temporary file, clean up on failure, and only then swap it into place. One line is a decoy.
lines: if err := d.WriteFile("db.tmp", encode(data)); err != nil {
explain: A plain write can be torn by a crash, but a rename is atomic. Writing to a temp file first means the real file is always either the old or the new version, never a mixture. `Disk` has no `Sync` here.
